rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fifteen builder trees go (ficus, magnolias, eucalyptus and jacarandas along the back fences, queen palms and magnolias 3 m from the house fronts); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the swing set, on the open lot corner, and in three back yards 5-10 m from the houses.

trees.why: the back yard with the swing set (2.8 m off): a young eucalyptus over the swings
the open lot corner at the south-east, 24 m from the walls: a full jacaranda
the south back lot line, 10 m from the houses: a jacaranda between two yards
the north back yard, 7 m from the house, 41 m from the swing-set tree
the north-west back yard, 5.4 m from the house: the yard's tree
